mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2D6, increasing fluphenazine levels; combined CNS depression and additive anticholinergic effects; potential for serotonin syndrome via different mechanisms.
action: Monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms, anticholinergic toxicity, and CNS depression; consider dose reduction of fluphenazine or alternative antipsychotic; baseline and periodic EKG recommended.
